meta.title: Contract Consumption Tracking: refused for a user without the Category Manager role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Category Manager role and verify that Contract Consumption Tracking is refused or absent.
Repeat the action as a Category Manager and verify that Contract Consumption Tracking is available.
Verify or select the Enterprise tenant because no tenant identifier is provided and the catalog cannot inspect plan access.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Category Manager role and verify that Contract Consumption Tracking is refused or absent.; Repeat the action as a Category Manager and verify that Contract Consumption Tracking is available.; Verify or select the Enterprise tenant because no tenant identifier is provided and the catalog cannot inspect plan access.

args.need: sign in as the non-Category Manager user and the Category Manager, use Contract Consumption Tracking to track value or quantity against a contract in the specified Enterprise tenant, and record whether the action is refused or absent for the first user and available for the Category Manager

steps.note: The catalog cannot switch role-based users, validate the Enterprise tenant, or operate the Contract Consumption Tracking feature.
Confirm the tested workflow ends on a screen that identifies the Contract Consumption Tracking feature.
